test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I __have been yet__ to go to the flower exhibition at Delhi University.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****have yet****'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**I have been yet to go**" is incorrect and awkwardly constructed.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**I have yet to go**," which appropriately conveys that the action has not been completed up to the present moment.
 
• Thus, the option "**have yet**" accurately replaces the underlined segment.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I **have yet** to go to the flower exhibition at Delhi University."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "have yet been"** – This option is incorrect as it is not grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 2: "have yet being"** – This option is incorrect because it uses an incorrect verb form "being."
 
• **Option 3: "had been yet"** – This option is incorrect because it changes the tense and structure inappropriately.
